dedupe_keys.name: eries thrust savonius wind turbine tunnel measurements

description: The ERIES THRUST team publishes wind-tunnel measurements for a small Savonius turbine tested at the University of Genoa in 2023. The own Zenodo manifest includes three stage-level Excel summaries, raw MATLAB time histories, acoustic WAV files and a short rotor-speed reading script. The article reports wind speeds up to 21 metres per second and rotor speeds up to 2,500 revolutions per minute under smooth and turbulent inflow. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. The measurements can calibrate small-turbine power, loading and noise components in distributed-generation simulations. A caveat is that wind-tunnel results for a 0.25-metre rotor do not directly give performance in urban turbulence or at commercial scale. Stages and instruments need alignment before fitting response curves. Own metadata and package names were read without downloading multi-gigabyte histories or reproducing calculations. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
